# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.39

Delivery Log Excel filename correction dated 2026-07-30.

## Fixed

- Delivery Log Excel downloads retain the readable report-reference `.xls`
  filename instead of a browser-generated UUID.
- Restores the UTF-8 BOM used by Excel and keeps the temporary download link
  available until the browser has started the download.

## Safety

- No database migration, workflow-action configuration, PDF, CSV, or business-
  data change.
- Install through Project Control option **8** then **15** only after tester
  validation.
